metadata.name: hub
metadata.description: $HUB protocol — stake-to-earn layer for OTC desk NFTs (community tooling)

instructions.name: activate_tier_otc
docs: §A4.1 #16 — `activate_tier` paid in $OTC at the 2× premium; proceeds → POL reserve.

instructions.name: claim_accrual
docs: Pays a wallet-level StakerAccrual (consignor share credits).

instructions.name: claim_airdrop
docs: §A7.1 #20 — a desk's current owner claims its snapshot allocation (one claim per asset).

accounts.name: claim
docs: Receipt — `init` (not `init_if_needed`) makes a second claim for the same desk fail.

instructions.name: claim_yield
docs: §B3 #5 (lazy revocation → #8 void_tier). One tx settles every closed round.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Permissionless: the math is deterministic, so anyone may close a round once the
threshold is met (they pay the next Epoch account's rent).

instructions.name: init_otc_payments
docs: §A4.1 #14 — authority creates the $OTC payment config + POL reserve pointer (disabled).

instructions.name: init_tokenomics
docs: §A7.1 #18 — authority records the supply plan + the vault $HUB account funding the airdrop.

accounts.name: epoch0
docs: Genesis epoch — the open epoch must always exist (§B3 #4 roll-forward chain).

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Must be `burn.authority`: fronts SOL for the market buy, reimbursed here on proof of burn.

instructions.name: register_consigned_inflow
docs: §B3 #6, source E — consignor-share split (§A6.1).

instructions.name: set_airdrop_root
docs: §A7.1 #19 — authority publishes the desk-snapshot Merkle root and opens/closes claims.

instructions.name: set_otc_rate
docs: §A4.1 #15 — authority refreshes the $OTC/SOL reference rate and the enable switch.

accounts.name: consign_epoch
docs: The consignment epoch must be closed so no round is double-counted (§A6.1).

instructions.name: upgrade_tier
docs: §B3 #3 — pays exactly `(target_tier - current) × step_fee`.

instructions.name: upgrade_tier_otc
docs: §A4.1 #17 — `upgrade_tier` paid in $OTC at the 2× premium; proceeds → POL reserve.

types.name: AirdropClaim
docs: `["airdrop", asset]` — one claim per desk asset; existence is the double-claim guard.

types.name: AirdropRootSet
docs: §A7.1 — snapshot published (or re-published before any claim) / claims toggled.

types.name: BurnState
docs: `Pot` is a system-owned PDA (`["pot"]`); balance = account lamports. It has
no data — liability is tracked on `Burn`/`Epoch` and Σ StakerAccrual.

fields.name: otc_program
docs: OTC-side references resolved at runtime (§A2), never hardcoded.

fields.name: min_pot_threshold_lamports
docs: A round closes once the open epoch's inflow reaches this (no clock involved).

fields.name: lp_phase2_open_ts
docs: §A6.2 phase-2 gate: HUB/OTC LP opens only after this timestamp (0 = closed).

fields.name: current_epoch
docs: Index of the open (accruing) epoch; `Epoch[current_epoch]` always exists.

fields.name: total_weight_bp
docs: Running Σw (bp) of non-voided DeskTiers; snapshotted into `Epoch` at finalize.

fields.name: pot_liability_lamports
docs: Lamports the pot owes (unclaimed allotments + burn-pending + carry). Pot ≥ this, always.

fields.name: acc_per_weight
docs: Cumulative lamports × ACC_SCALE credited per bp of weight (OTC "counter"). A tier's
pending yield is `(acc − stamp) × w / ACC_SCALE`, so one claim settles every round.

fields.name: dust_scaled
docs: Scaled lamports credited to the accumulator but owed to nobody (claim floor remainders,
ceil slack at finalize, forfeits of voided tiers). Whole lamports re-enter as inflow at
the next finalize, so the pot stays zero-sum.

types.name: ConfigField
docs: Fields `update_config` may touch (§B3 #9). Rate changes apply to future epochs.

fields.name: owner_at_activation
docs: Owner at activation; re-verified lazily at claim/upgrade (§B3 #5).

fields.name: stamp_acc_per_weight
docs: `Config.acc_per_weight` at activation / last claim (OTC "stamp").

fields.name: total_claimed_lamports
docs: Lifetime SOL this desk has been paid by `claim_yield` (reset on re-activation).

types.name: Epoch
docs: One round of the pot. Opens at the previous finalize, closes when inflow ≥ threshold.

fields.name: finalized_ts
docs: 0 while open.

fields.name: distributed_lamports
docs: Lamports credited to stakers through `acc_per_weight` at finalize.

fields.name: rolled_forward_lamports
docs: `distributable − distributed` (≤ 1 lamport of floor loss) → next epoch's opening inflow.

fields.name: total_weight_bp
docs: Σw of non-voided DeskTiers at finalize (bp-weighted).

fields.name: per_weight_scaled
docs: This round's increment of `acc_per_weight` and the counter value after it.

types.name: InflowSource
docs: §A5 inflow sources. `E` (consigned desk yield) uses `register_consigned_inflow`.

fields.name: min_pot_threshold_lamports
docs: 0 → Appendix default (MIN_POT_THRESHOLD_LAMPORTS = 0.1 SOL).

types.name: OtcPayConfig
docs: §A4.1 `["otc_pay"]` — $OTC as an alternative step-fee currency. Created by the authority
after `initialize_config` (no `Config` migration); absent ⇒ the path does not exist.

fields.name: otc_per_sol
docs: Reference rate: $OTC base units per 1 SOL, refreshed by the authority (`set_otc_rate`).

fields.name: premium_bp
docs: Premium over the SOL step-fee value (bp). Written from `OTC_PREMIUM_BP`, never updated.

fields.name: pol_account
docs: Token account (mint = `Config.otc_mint`, owner = `["vault"]` PDA) that receives every $OTC
fee. Program-custodied and reserved for the $OTC/$HUB POL leg (`build_lp(HubOtc)`).

types.name: StakerAccrual
docs: Per-wallet consignor ledger (`["accrual", wallet]`): consignor-share credits still owed,
plus the lifetime total paid out by `claim_accrual`. Created by the treasury on the first
consigned inflow for that wallet.

types.name: TierPaidOtc
docs: §A4.1 — step(s) paid in $OTC at the 2× premium; nothing enters the pot, the $OTC lands in the
POL reserve. `from_tier == 0` is a fresh activation.

types.name: TierVoided
docs: §B3 #8 — ownership changed since activation; no refund. Pending yield is forfeited to dust.

types.name: TokenomicsConfig
docs: §A7.1 `["tokenomics"]` — the supply allocation plan, on-chain so the dashboard and token-info
submissions read one source. Created by the authority after `initialize_config` (same
pattern as `OtcPayConfig`: no `Config` migration). Shares are bp of `max_supply_units`;
the airdrop share is derived from the desk count at snapshot, never typed in.

fields.name: snapshot_desk_count
docs: Desk assets counted at the airdrop snapshot (0 until `set_airdrop_root`).

fields.name: airdrop_units
docs: `snapshot_desk_count × airdrop_per_desk_units` — exact; `airdrop_bp` is the floored share.

fields.name: public_bp
docs: Public / OTC-launch share: whatever remains once airdrop + treasury lock + team are out.

fields.name: airdrop_root
docs: Merkle root over `keccak(AIRDROP_LEAF_TAG ‖ asset ‖ amount_le)`; zero until published.

fields.name: airdrop_vault
docs: Vault-owned $HUB token account that funds claims (mint = `Config.hub_mint`).

fields.name: vault
docs: Program-signed custody PDA (`["vault"]`) that owns consigned desks.

fields.name: lp_hub_sol_active
docs: §A6.2 — one position per pair, HODL both legs.

types.name: YieldClaimed
docs: One claim settles every round closed since the tier's stamp.
